### Config.PermissionMapping

Key: `permissions`

Permissions defines which SonarQube project permissions Guassp manages for each
GitLab project access level. Use it to adapt GitLab roles to the permissions
enabled in SonarQube. If omitted, Guassp uses its built-in role mapping.
Providing a mapping replaces that policy; a level with an empty list has no
managed permissions.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`PermissionMapping`](#permissionmapping) (`#/$defs/PermissionMapping`) |

### Config.VisibilityOptions

Key: `visibility`

Visibility controls whether SonarQube project visibility follows the
corresponding GitLab project. This is useful when public and private projects
must retain the same exposure after synchronization. Set enabled to false to
leave SonarQube visibility unchanged, or provide a map to choose how each GitLab
visibility is represented.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`VisibilityOptions`](#visibilityoptions) (`#/$defs/VisibilityOptions`) |

## GitLabOptions

GitLabOptions configures the GitLab instance used as the source of projects,
memberships, and user identities.

### GitLabOptions.url

Key: `url`

Path: [`gitlab`](#configgitlaboptions).`url`

URL is the address of the GitLab instance. Include any path prefix used by a
self-managed installation so API requests reach the correct instance.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `https://gitlab.example.com` |
| Format | `uri` |
| Constraints | `minLength=1`; `pattern=^https?://` |

### GitLabOptions.token

Key: `token`

Path: [`gitlab`](#configgitlaboptions).`token`

Token authenticates Guassp's GitLab API requests. Use the read_api scope and
grant its account access to every bound project and its effective member list.
The scope permits API reads; account access determines which projects and
memberships are visible. This service credential is separate from CI job tokens
used for individual sync requests.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `${GITLAB_TOKEN:?set GITLAB_TOKEN}` |
| Write only | yes |
| Constraints | `minLength=1` |

### GitLabOptions.skip_users

Key: `skip_users`

Path: [`gitlab`](#configgitlaboptions).`skip_users`

SkipUsers lists GitLab user IDs whose access Guassp must not manage. Use this to
preserve manually maintained SonarQube access for selected accounts.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `integer` |
| Items constraints | `minimum=1` |

### SonarQubeOptions.token

Key: `token`

Path: [`sonarqube`](#configsonarqubeoptions).`token`

Token authenticates Guassp's SonarQube Web API requests and must be a user
token. Current project discovery and user directory API calls require global
Administer System permission. User deactivation also requires this permission
and affects the entire SonarQube instance.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |

### SonarQubeOptions.alm_key

Key: `alm_key`

Path: [`sonarqube`](#configsonarqubeoptions).`alm_key`

ALMKey selects the GitLab ALM configuration whose project bindings Guassp should
use when SonarQube has more than one GitLab configuration. Leave it empty to use
the available binding without an additional ALM filter.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `gitlab` |

### SonarQubeOptions.skip_groups

Key: `skip_groups`

Path: [`sonarqube`](#configsonarqubeoptions).`skip_groups`

SkipGroups names SonarQube groups whose members Guassp should leave untouched. A

| Required | no |
| Items type | `string` |

## VisibilityOptions

VisibilityOptions controls whether and how GitLab project visibility is
reflected in SonarQube.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### VisibilityOptions.enabled

Key: `enabled`

Path: [`visibility`](#configvisibilityoptions).`enabled`

Enabled turns visibility reconciliation on or off. When disabled, Guassp does
not change the existing SonarQube project visibility.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `true` |

### VisibilityOptions.map

Key: `map`

Path: [`visibility`](#configvisibilityoptions).`map`

Map translates GitLab public, internal, and private visibility into SonarQube
public or private visibility. A custom map replaces the built-in mapping, so
include each GitLab visibility that can occur. If omitted, the built-in mapping
is used.

| Attribute | Value |

| Required | no |
| Additional properties type | `string` |

## DiscoveryOptions

DiscoveryOptions controls how Guassp finds the SonarQube project for a GitLab
project and refreshes the set of projects to synchronize.

| Attribute | Value |

| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |

### DiscoveryOptions.full_sync_at

Key: `full_sync_at`

Path: [`discovery`](#configdiscoveryoptions).`full_sync_at`

FullSyncAt schedules a daily refresh of GitLab-bound SonarQube projects at local
service time. Leave it empty to turn off scheduled full discovery cycles.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `03:00` |
| Constraints | `pattern=^([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$\|^$` |

### DiscoveryOptions.manual_full_sync

Key: `manual_full_sync`

Path: [`discovery`](#configdiscoveryoptions).`manual_full_sync`

ManualFullSync enables POST /api/v1/full-sync and its button in the web console.
The API uses api.token and the button follows the web Basic authentication
settings. Leave it disabled when users must not trigger a full sync.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |

### DiscoveryOptions.path_fallback

Key: `path_fallback`

Path: [`discovery`](#configdiscoveryoptions).`path_fallback`

PathFallback lets Guassp look for a SonarQube project with the same full GitLab
path when no usable ALM binding identifies one. It is intended for installations
where project bindings are missing; ambiguous matches are not selected.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |

## Example yaml document

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woozymasta/guassp/HEAD/internal/config/generated/guassp.schema.json

# GitLab contains the source server address and credentials
# used to discover projects, memberships, and user information.
gitlab:
  # URL is the address of the GitLab instance.
  # Include any path prefix used by a self-managed installation so API requests reach the correct instance.
  # Example: https://gitlab.example.com
  url: https://gitlab.example.com
  # Token authenticates Guassp's GitLab API requests.
  # Use the read_api scope and grant its account access to every bound project and its effective member list.
  # The scope permits API reads; account access determines which projects and memberships are visible.
  # This service credential is separate from CI job tokens used for individual sync requests.
  # Example: ${GITLAB_TOKEN:?set GITLAB_TOKEN}
  token: ${GITLAB_TOKEN:?set GITLAB_TOKEN}
# SonarQube contains the destination server address and credentials used for API requests.
# ALM and group settings further narrow which bindings or users are managed.
sonarqube:
  # URL is the address of the SonarQube instance.
  # Include its context path when the server is hosted below a URL prefix.
  # Example: https://sonar.example.com
  url: https://sonar.example.com
  # Token authenticates Guassp's SonarQube Web API requests and must be a user token.
  # Current project discovery and user directory API calls require global Administer System permission.
  # User deactivation also requires this permission and affects the entire SonarQube instance.
  # Example: ${SONARQUBE_TOKEN:?set SONARQUBE_TOKEN}
  token: ${SONARQUBE_TOKEN:?set SONARQUBE_TOKEN}
```
